caption: The drawing is a technical line sketch in black ink on a beige, slightly yellowed background. It depicts a piece of furniture, labeled as a “Writing Desk & Bookcase,” presented in two views: a front elevation on the left and a side elevation on the right. The furniture has a rectangular base supported by four decorative legs with ornate detailing at the top and bottom. Above the legs is a lower cabinet section with two rectangular paneled doors. On top of this sits a desk section that projects slightly outward. Above the desk, there is an upper section with two taller cabinet doors, each featuring a diamond lattice pattern overlay. The top of the furniture is finished with a corniced molding. Dimensions are noted throughout the drawing: the full height is 7’4”, the width is 3’6”, and the depth is 1’8½”. The cornice overhangs by 10½". Annotations in the lower right corner include the object’s name and the name “Henry Meyers.” The composition is minimal, containing straight, precise lines with measured notations, all set against the unadorned background.
